mutations.name: V1 the filter moves after the history fetch, so every event channel is enumerated and read and then thrown away: unbounded work to display nothing, and invisible to any assertion about the final snapshot
mutations.expectRed: NO event channel was ever asked for history (the filter runs BEFORE the fetch)

mutations.name: V2 the tab filter is dropped, so the strip carries one row per agent that has ever run and buries the channels a human talks on
V3 the live-arrival filter is dropped, so an event channel appears as a tab the moment a frame lands and vanishes at the next poll, which reads as a flickering bug rather than a filter
mutations.expectRed: a live frame on an event channel does not add a tab

mutations.name: V4 the feed row stops being marked, so every surface has to re-derive the classification locally and three copies get three chances to disagree
mutations.expectRed: it is MARKED as event traffic
